pipeline.labels: synthetic independent continuous regression or3class float32; no real quality data

input_policy: Each shape/distribution has deterministic independent training and request draws. All batches use prefixes of the same2048-row request. Both arms share identical frames and fitted state.
scope: FeaturePipeline.transform_array plus fresh shallow DataFrame copy per call; no tree inference or benchmark normalization adapter. Code plan derived once outside measured calls. Candidate helper is identical to frozen broad-dispatch prototype.

guard_selection.rule: Choose the lowest threshold for which EVERY shape/cardinality/distribution at every tested batch>=threshold has pooled median speedup>=1.05 and both paired-order speedups>=1.00. Otherwise retain no automatic dictionary dispatch. No fixture-specific width/cardinality thresholds.
guard_selection.independent_real_replication: Before production, freeze selected row threshold and compare all5 saved real fixtures in balanced order at1,64,128,256,512,1000,2048 rows. Preserve exact transform/prediction parity. Require each eligible row>=threshold to improve in both orderings, aggregate raw speedup>=1, and fallback controls without repeated>3pct slowdown. A failure rejects this guard rather than tuning it from real fixtures.

limitations: Local CPU/pandas2 object-string categorical serving experiment, not accuracy or statistical generalization evidence; sparse/highcardinality/mixed/custom inputs remain fallback.
